name: print-social-purple-fintech-welcome-post-with-3d-coins
title: Purple welcome post with a smiling person, 3D coins and notification card
whatItIs: A violet square post with a bold white welcome headline, a smiling man in a patterned sweater on an orange armchair holding a phone and waving, glossy gold coins flanking him, sparkle stars, a white transfer-success notification card and a URL pill with store icons.
whatItMeans: Friendly, joyful and easy to trust; the notification card proves the product works.
techniques: Place a cut-out photo on a violet field with radiating light.
Overlay a fake notification as proof of the feature.
Float glossy 3D coins around the person.
Use a URL pill and store icons as a footer.

vocabulary.definition: A UI notification card used as evidence of function.
A glossy rendered coin used as a money symbol.
A soft burst of light behind a subject.
A rounded capsule containing a web address.
